body.name: Real
body.def: If \(\operatorname{RepGraph}(\eta,B)=(\widetilde S,\widetilde G_0,(\widetilde T_k)_{k=1}^{K})\), then \(\operatorname{Real}(\eta,B)\) contains exactly the law-level models \(\widetilde\eta\) in \(\mathfrak M_{D,K}^{\mathrm{Dai}}\) with \(S_{\widetilde\eta}=\widetilde S\), \(G_0(\widetilde\eta)=\widetilde G_0\), and \(T_k(\widetilde\eta)=\widetilde T_k\) for every \(k\).
